marker_convention_correction.defect: world_xz_blocks recorded the marker BlockPos (block MIN corner) while the image convention detects the top-face CENTRE. The uniform (-0.5,-0.5) mismatch injected a constant-sign ~0.5-block frame shift into the fitted homography -> the wall-parallel localization bias (median 0.4221, p95 0.5885) Person E measured.
marker_convention_correction.fix: world_xz_blocks := BlockPos + (0.5, 0.5) (top-face centre); y-plane unchanged at 4. Input-geometry correction, NOT a probe-derived +0.5 output offset (that would fit the symptom; this fixes the cause).
marker_convention_correction.proof: synthetic pinhole homography over this layout's marker rectangle: corner-labelled markers -> 0.5000 median abs wall-parallel error, all same sign; top-face-centre-labelled -> 0.0000. No evaluation probe used.
